interaction.prompt: Your D has the puck under forecheck pressure. Drag your three forwards to where they belong for a clean breakout: wingers on the walls, centre in the middle to support.

feedback.right: Clean breakout shape: a winger on each wall and your centre in the middle giving a short, safe outlet. Now your D has three options.
feedback.wrong: Bunching up or leaving a wall empty gives your D nowhere to go. Spread out: a winger on each wall, centre in the middle for support.

tip: On a breakout, give your D options: wingers stretch to the walls, centre supports in the middle lane.
why: Spacing is the breakout. Wingers on the walls and a centre in the middle give the puck-carrier three safe outlets instead of a forced play.
